limitations: Ranks only resolved reviewed references associated with the named official/community catalogs; this is not a universal geospatial-literature ranking.
Frozen group geography labels do not always state numeric latitude limits; null latitude_limit means no numeric bound was asserted.
Citations are frozen and not re-counted; count is maximum associated dataset-paper cited_by_count, not a sum. Data DOI citations remain separate in source rankings.
Format, licensing and native bulk hosting are unknown unless supported by product-specific primary evidence.

Where one frozen paper group contains multiple community entries, candidates are split by exact source entry ID and mapped independently to canonical audit.family_key records; the frozen 50-group selection remains untouched.
The TerraClimate community +2C/+4C scenario record and official historical baseline are separate candidates despite sharing the TerraClimate family paper.
